name: Braconnier Dam Campground
note: Kneehill County campground of 8 unserviced stalls along a natural draw just off Highway 21 south of Three Hills, beside a small dammed pond that is not stocked; swimming and power boats are not allowed on it. Outhouses and a municipal water tap, no dump station (the nearest are in Torrington and Three Hills). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Kneehill County page kneehillcounty.com/2200/Braconnier-Dam + FAQ (read 2026-11-10): county campground, 8 stalls with picnic tables and fire pits, outhouses, water tap, unserviced C$25, reservations through Let's Camp; Let's Camp camp braconnier-dam (read 2026-11-10): live, online bookings on, 8 reservable sites 1-8 for tent or RV, pads 30-50 ft, maxRvLength 40-50 ft; Esri imagery 2026-11-10: gravel road and site clearings in a shelterbelt west of the pond -> real drive-in county campground a 23-ft rig fits. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-10 (500 m crop and z18/z16 tiles around 51.66768,-113.23862, all rendered): the stalls sit in a treed clearing 35-45 m west of the water with a band of trees and shrubs between; Let's Camp map shows the same tree band, and the site 7 photo shows the water through trees past a wire fence. The water is a small pond (about 1.5 ha on imagery; county: 'small, dammed water body'), so no view value; DEM 886 m at the sites vs 883 m on the water. Not waterfront.
fees_source: https://kneehillcounty.com/2200/Braconnier-Dam (read 2026-11-10): 'Camping Fees: Unserviced site- $25'; Let's Camp rules: fee schedule as posted includes GST. Let's Camp per-site rates read 0 off season.
flags: Not on RV Life (Algolia 5 km radius and name search find nothing).
Hookups: none (Let's Camp: every site water/sewer false, electrical null; map titled 'No Serviced Sites').

Season May-September; Let's Camp status 'closed' now, 2027 reservations open February/March 2027 (bio still carries the 2025 dates May 16 - Sep 14). Max stay 14 nights, min 1, check-in 1 pm / out 11 am.
Phone is the Kneehill County park host (in season, same as 9043); county office 403-443-5541 off season.
